subject: Geo-certification and non-replication proof request for Dedicated cluster - Clearpath
messages:
From: Elena Park <security@clearpath.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@clearpath.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: geo-certification and non-replication proof for dedicated cluster

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our vendor onboarding checklist we need a short packet showing that the dedicated cluster we plan to use for Clearpath is both region-pinned and not replicated outside the designated US region. Specifically we need: 

- a short summary of where customer data is residency-bound (region/zone),
- a signed statement or attestation language your legal/security team accepts for SOC/assessment evidence,
- a short sample of operational logs showing the tenant pinning event and a snapshot that proves non-replication (we understand redaction of sensitive tokens), and
- the retention and deletion procedure (timelines and who executes the wipe).

We are targeting our procurement deadline the week of Nov 8 and would appreciate receiving the packet by Nov 2 so we can include it in our internal review. Attached is our one-page checklist to align scope. Also happy to do a 30-min call if that helps.

Thanks,
Elena
Security Program Manager
Clearpath Systems

Attachments: clearpath-request-checklist.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <security@clearpath.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@clearpath.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: geo-certification and non-replication proof for dedicated cluster

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you requested. Quick notes:

- Summary: we will produce a one-page residency matrix that shows the dedicated pool, region pin timestamp, and the non-replication assurance for the customer tenant (no cross-region replication for tenant volumes).
- Attestation: our security team can provide a short attestation statement referencing our internal controls; if you have required language (for your auditors) please paste it and we will aim to match it.
- Logs/snapshot: we can redact any PII and provide time-bound gating artifacts.
- Deletion: we will include our standard dedicated wipe runbook plus an example play-by-play for a tenant tombstone operation.

We plan to deliver the packet by Mon Nov 2 in the morning PST. Can we schedule a 30-minute sync on Tue Nov 3 to walk through artifacts and acceptability? Suggested times: 09:00 or 13:00 PT.

I will loop in our ops and security folks to assemble the artifacts.

—Laura Bennett
Head of Cloud Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (we will attach) redwood-residency-summary.csv, pinning-playbook.md
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Clearpath request - artifacts and responsibilities

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Clearpath's ask. Action items below (timeline: assemble by Nov 2, handoff to Laura for final packet):

Ben: please pull the tenant pin event and associated KV snapshot from the dedicated pool logs and prepare a redacted tarball. Include a README that explains the fields and the exact UTC timestamps. Name the archive deployment-pin-log.tar.gz.

Marissa: work with Security to draft the attestation language (1–3 short paragraphs) that references non-replication, region pinning, and the wipe procedures. If Clearpath provides auditor text, we'll map fields. Also include an excerpt from the wipe runbook that lists RPO/RTO and the steps executed during a tombstone.

Ben / Marissa — two asks on format: 
- Logs: CSV + small README, do not include raw keys or tokens.
- Attestation: signatory should be the Head of Cloud Compliance or Security (Laura or Ben).

I'll coordinate final assembly and upload to the shared drive. Ping me if any blockers.

On Oct 29, 2026 11:05 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you requested....

—Laura
From: Elena Park <security@clearpath.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@clearpath.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: geo-certification and non-replication proof for dedicated cluster

Laura — received the packet, thank you. The residency matrix and logs look good from a scope perspective. A couple of small follow-ups before we close our procurement loop: 

1) Can you include an explicit statement confirming that backups created from this tenant are also region-bound and not replicated to other regions?
2) For the wipe play-by-play, can you add the internal ticket IDs and the timestamp format you use (UTC preferred) so our auditors can reconcile them with our intake system?

We'd also like the attestation PDF signed by an authorized Redwood exec (PDF with digital signature is fine). If you can provide those three items by COB Nov 4, we will mark the security gating as satisfied.

If helpful, we'll take the Nov 3 sync to review the wording — earlier you suggested 09:00 PT; that works for us. Please send a calendar invite.

Thanks again,
Elena Park
Security Program Manager
Clearpath Systems

Attachments: clearpath-request-checklist.pdf
